text: Everything that savors of mystery charms them. So you have seen the arm, that was all. You would meet the queen, and she would not know who you are?” “No; but thanks to this diamond,” replied the young man. “Listen,” said M. de Tréville; “shall I give you counsel, good counsel, the counsel of a friend?” “You will do me honor, monsieur,” said D’Artagnan. “Well, then, off to the nearest goldsmith’s, and sell that diamond for the highest price you can get from him.
